name: 13_instagram_comment_trigger

nodes.name: Instagram Comment Webhook
nodes.notes: Meta Instagram Graph API webhook for comments. Configure in Meta App Dashboard → Instagram → Webhooks. Subscribe to: comments, mentions.

nodes.name: Extract Headers & Tenant ID
nodes.notes: Extract headers for signature verification and tenant_id from query params

nodes.name: Verify Meta Instagram Signature
nodes.notes: Production security: Verify Meta Instagram webhook signature (X-Hub-Signature-256). Reject if invalid (401).

nodes.name: Parse Instagram Comment
nodes.notes: Parse Instagram comment webhook payload. Extract: comment_id, comment_text, media_id, user_id, username.

nodes.name: Detect Lead Keywords
nodes.notes: Detect lead intent keywords: DM, Price, YES, Interested, Buy. Supports English, Swahili, Sheng.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { message: 'Comment processed but no lead intent detected', comment_id: $json.comment_id } }}

nodes.name: Return No Intent (200)
nodes.notes: Return 200 if no lead intent (comment logged but no action taken)

nodes.name: Fetch Instagram User Bio
nodes.notes: Fetch Instagram user bio to extract phone number. Uses Instagram Graph API: GET /{user_id}?fields=biography

nodes.name: Extract Phone from Bio
nodes.notes: Extract phone number from Instagram bio using Kenyan phone patterns. Normalize to +254 format.

nodes.name: Create Lead Record
nodes.notes: Create lead record in Supabase leads table. Links Instagram comment to lead for attribution.

nodes.name: Trigger WhatsApp Auto-DM
nodes.notes: Trigger WhatsApp catalog message workflow. Passes lead data (phone, tenant_id) to send catalog message.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { message: 'Lead created but no phone number found. Manual follow-up required.', lead_id: $json.id } }}

nodes.name: Return No Phone (200)
nodes.notes: Return 200 if lead created but no phone (requires manual follow-up)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { message: 'Lead created and WhatsApp DM sent', lead_id: $('Create Lead Record').first().json.id, phone: $('Extract Phone from Bio').first().json.phone } }}

nodes.name: Return Success (200)
nodes.notes: Return 200 if lead created and WhatsApp DM sent successfully

notes:
✅ WEEK 1 CORE ENGINE: Instagram Comment → Lead → WhatsApp Auto-DM

✅ SECURITY: Meta Instagram webhook signature verification (X-Hub-Signature-256)
✅ KEYWORD DETECTION: DM, Price, YES, Interested, Buy (English, Swahili, Sheng)
✅ PHONE EXTRACTION: From Instagram bio using Kenyan phone patterns (+254, 07, 254)
✅ LEAD CREATION: Creates lead record in Supabase with attribution data
✅ WHATSAPP HANDOFF: Triggers WhatsApp catalog workflow if phone found

Reference: docs/core/NAIROBI_SUPER_SUITE_EXPANSION.md
API: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api/guides/webhooks
